mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units indicates strengthening consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to improved business confidence and equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: HOUST increases by ≥0.5% from prior month in >50% of instances where S&P 500 20-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity risk premiums, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.0 in >50% of instances where S&P 500 5-day returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL inflation above 3.0% and FEDFUNDS below 3.5% indicates policy misalignment where inflation expectations outpace rate adjustments, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS < 3.5 in >50% of instances where S&P 500 5-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.0%) trigger fiscal stimulus expectations, strengthening equity demand and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.0 in >50% of instances where S&P 500 60-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) trend above 109.0 indicates manufacturing sector resilience, which correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: INDPRO increases by ≥0.3% from prior month in >50% of instances where S&P 500 20-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) fall below 500,000 million dollars, it signals deteriorating consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue forecasts.
failure_condition: RSAFS < 500000 in >50% of instances where S&P 500 5-day returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 and retail sales (RSAFS) above 500,000 million dollars indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through sustained corporate profit growth.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 500000 in >50% of instances where S&P 500 20-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) with persistent rate hikes cause equity market volatility, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as risk-off sentiment dominates.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.5 in >50% of instances where S&P 500 60-day returns are positive.
